metaTitle: The page's <title> and og:title. Keep it within about 60 Latin or 30 CJK characters, as search results show it whole.
metaDescription: The meta description and og:description. 120 to 160 characters in English, about 50 to 90 in Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
metaImageAlt: Alt text of the link preview image (media/og/<code>.png): the icon and headline beside a crop of the overview screenshot.
ogTagline: The short line under the headline in the link preview image only.
skipToContent: The skip link, the first thing a keyboard reaches.
homeLabel: Accessible name of the logo link in the header and the footer.
navLabel: Accessible name of the header's section links.
navFeatures: Header link to the features section.
navDevelopers: Header link to the For developers section.
navSafety: Header link to the safety section.
navDownload: Header link to the download section.
languageLabel: Accessible name of the language menu and the footer's language links.
githubLabel: Accessible name of the header's GitHub link.
heroTitle: The headline. \n is a line break in Latin text; Chinese and Japanese may break where the line reads well, or not at all.
heroTitleMark: The part of heroTitle drawn in amber; must appear in heroTitle exactly.
heroDownloadMac: The main button: downloads the disk image for Apple silicon.
heroOtherSystems: Second hero button, which leads to the download section's Windows and Intel downloads.
heroMeta: Small line under the buttons. {version} is the app's version. Pages other than Simplified Chinese say the interface is in Simplified Chinese.
shotOverviewAlt: Alt text of the overview screenshot in the hero; also the caption of the screenshot in the structured data.
stepsEyebrow: Small label above the three steps.
stepCheckBody: Step 1 text. Checks are read-only and run only on power and when the computer is not busy.
stepActBody: Step 3 text. Undo exists on macOS only.
recEyebrow: Label of the recommendations row; the app's 概览 page.
recBody: The quoted card titles translate the app's Chinese cards; keep them as quotations in the language's own quotation marks.
shotToastAlt: Alt text of the screenshot of recommendation cards with the undo message.
undoTitle: Heading of the undo row. Put back is the macOS Finder's own term in each language.
undoBody: The quoted message translates the app's toast 「已移到废纸篓 2.1 GB · 撤销」. History is the app's 操作历史 page.
shotHistoryAlt: Alt text of the History screenshot.
spaceEyebrow: Label of the Space Lens row; the app's 空间透视 page.
spaceTitle: Heading of the Space Lens row.
spaceBody: Finder and Explorer are the macOS and Windows file managers, by their names in the language.
shotSpaceAlt: Alt text of the Space Lens treemap screenshot. Folder names stay in English as the screenshot shows them.
growthBody: The quoted example translates the app's 「从周三到现在涨了 6.2 GB」; keep the path as it is.
shotGrowthAlt: Alt text of the screenshot of recent changes over 7 days.
uninstallEyebrow: Label of the uninstall row; the app's 应用卸载 page.
uninstallBody: macOS moves the app and its leftovers to the Trash; Windows runs the program's own uninstaller first.
shotUninstallAlt: Alt text of the uninstall screenshot. App names stay as they are.
autoEyebrow: Label of the automatic cleaning row, a macOS-only feature.
autoTitle: Heading of the automatic cleaning row.
autoBody: The four rules, all off by default, that only move files to the Trash.
autoPoint1: Point under the automatic cleaning text: the weekly summary on Mondays.
autoPoint2: Point under the automatic cleaning text: items you put back are never taken again.
shotAutoAlt: Alt text of the automatic cleaning settings screenshot.
menubarTitle: Heading of the menu bar card, a macOS-only feature.
menubarBody: The menu bar icon and the optional low-space notification.
trayNormalAlt: Alt text of the menu bar icon.
trayAlertAlt: Alt text of the menu bar icon shown when space runs low.
devEyebrow: Label of the For developers section.
devTitle: Heading of the For developers section.
devBody: Text between ` is set as code (folder names); keep the backticks in pairs.
devPoint1: Point: the tool caches. Tool names stay as they are.
devPoint2: Point: the kinds of project. Names stay as they are.
devPoint3: Point: the app's 无法确定 state, in quotation marks.
shotDevAlt: Alt text of the projects screenshot. Project names stay as they are.
cliTitle: Heading of the command line part.
cliBody: Commands and flags between ` stay in English and are set as code.
cliCommentScan: Comment above `spruce recommendations --json` in the terminal example.
cliCommentDry: Comment above `spruce clean --dry-run` in the terminal example.
cliCommentProjects: Comment above `spruce projects` in the terminal example.
cliReadme: Link to the README's command line section in the page's language.
detailsEyebrow: Small label of the section of smaller features.
detailsTitle: Heading of the section of smaller features.
shotHealthAlt: Alt text of the Health screenshot.
detailJunkTitle: Card title: the app's 系统垃圾 page.
detailJunkBody: Card text: what system junk covers, and that browser cookies, history and logins are not touched.
detailMaintTitle: Card title: the app's 维护 page.
detailMaintBody: Card text: the maintenance tasks. Use the system's own names for Spotlight, Quick Look and the Open With menu in the language.
detailHealthTitle: Card title: the app's 健康监测 page.
detailHealthBody: Card text: Spruce shows processes and never ends them.
detailHistoryTitle: Card title: the app's 操作历史 page.
detailExclBody: Card text: folders or patterns Spruce never touches.
detailLowBody: Card text: off by default, at most once a day.
safetyEyebrow: Small label of the safety section.
safety1Body: Safety point 1: background checks are read-only.
safety2Body: Safety point 2: the three kinds of card action; the last two always confirm.
safety3Body: Safety point 3: every item is checked again right before it is moved or deleted.
safety4Body: Safety point 4. Use the system's own names of the folders (Documents, Desktop, Pictures, iCloud Drive) in the language; `~/.ssh` stays as it is.
safety5Body: Safety point 5: what Spruce never does by itself.
privacyTitle: Heading of the privacy card in the safety section.
privacyBody: Privacy: no account; data stays in the data folder. Do not add claims about the network.
dlEyebrow: Small label of the download section.
dlTitle: Heading of the download section; {version} is the app's version.
dlBody: Text beside the downloads: the license and what each release holds.
dlGitHub: Button to the repository on GitHub.
dlAll: Button to every release on GitHub.
dlLang: Note shown on every page but the Simplified Chinese one: the interface language.
dlTabsLabel: Accessible name of the macOS and Windows tabs.
dlMacBody: macOS tab text. The disk images are signed and notarized.
dlMacButton: macOS tab: the Apple silicon disk image.
dlMacIntel: macOS tab: the Intel disk image.
dlMacScript: macOS tab: above the install command.
dlWinBody: Windows tab text. The installer installs for the current user only.
dlWinUnsigned: Windows tab: the installers are not code-signed yet. The button names are SmartScreen's own in the language.
dlWinScript: Windows tab: above the install command.
dlWinLimits: Windows tab: what Windows does not have yet.
copyLabel: Button that copies an install command.
copiedLabel: The copy button just after it copied.
faqLead: Under the questions' heading, before faqAsk.
faqAskFirstA: Answer: nothing is deleted for good, no command runs and the Trash is not emptied without asking.
faqRestoreA: Answer: Undo and Put back on macOS; the Recycle Bin on Windows.
faqBackgroundA: Answer. Settings › General names the app's 设置 › 通用.
faqDataA: Answer. Do not add claims about the network.
faqDiskAccessQ: Question. Full Disk Access is macOS's own name for the permission in the language.
faqDiskAccessA: Answer: the permission is optional and never requested by a background check.
faqPasswordA: Answer: only flushing DNS and rebuilding a broken Spotlight index need administrator rights.
faqCodeA: Answer. Folder names between ` are set as code.
faqWindowsA: Answer: what Windows does not have yet.
faqEnglishQ: Question about the interface language; each page may ask about its own language.
faqEnglishA: Answer: the interface is in Simplified Chinese only.
faqUpdateA: Answer: there is no updater in the app.
faqPriceA: Answer: free and open source under the MIT license.
ctaTitle: Heading of the closing call to download.
ctaNote: Fine print under the closing button, before the link ctaOther.
ctaOther: Link to the download section for the other downloads.
footerLicense: Footer link to the LICENSE file.
footerLinksLabel: Accessible name of the footer's project links.
notFoundTitle: Heading and title of 404.html, which shows every language.
notFoundBody: Text of 404.html under the heading, in the first language only.
notFoundHome: Link from 404.html to the language's home page.
